column1: # Setup tier of every Sable application (Sable OS 2.0 setup tiers spec).
#   package   application id; must match a row of apps.tsv, or be one of the LineageOS apps below
#   tier      core        always on, not removable in setup
#             recommended on by default, can be switched off in setup
#             optional    off by default, switched on in setup or in Settings
#   requires  comma-separated packages that must stay enabled while this one is on, or -
# The apps are all in the image; setup enables or disables them for the user (SableAppSet).
# apps.tsv stays the build list. A row there with enabled=no has no row here.
